name: Table Mountain
description: A flat-topped mountain above Cape Town, reached by cableway or trails.

name: Robben Island
description: Former political prison island in Table Bay, reached by ferry from the V&A Waterfront.

name: Union Buildings
description: Herbert Baker’s sandstone government buildings overlook Pretoria.

name: Voortrekker Monument
description: A large granite monument on a hill south of Pretoria.

name: Castle of Good Hope
description: A pentagonal fort from the Dutch East India Company era in central Cape Town.

name: Kruger National Park
description: A vast safari park of the Big Five with rest camps and game drives.

name: Garden Route
description: Coastal forests, lagoons and towns along the southern Cape.

name: uKhahlamba-Drakensberg
description: Basalt escarpment with hiking and San rock art sites.

name: Boulders Beach
description: African penguins nest among granite boulders near Cape Town.

name: V&A Waterfront
description: A working harbour precinct of shops, museums and ferry points.

name: Bo-Kaap kitchens
description: Colourful Cape Malay neighbourhood known for spice kitchens and cobbled streets.

name: Neighbourgoods Market
description: A weekend food market in the Old Biscuit Mill, Woodstock.

name: Neighbourgoods Braamfontein
description: A popular Saturday food market in Braamfontein.

name: Victoria Street Market
description: Indian spice and fabric market near Durban’s CBD.

name: Pretoria café streets
description: Cafés around Hatfield and the CBD.

name: Cape Town International Jazz Festival
description: A major March jazz festival at the Cape Town International Convention Centre.
